updates.body: 新增「总表速览」板块：篇章/破境/宝物/人物四表支持排序、筛选、行展开收起；全局展开收起按钮；人物关系图谱升级缩放控件、边类型筛选、搜索定位与详情面板。
updates.body_en: New tables section: arcs/breakthroughs/treasures/characters tables with sorting, filtering, expandable rows; global expand/collapse; relationship graph upgraded with zoom controls, edge-type filters, search-locate and detail panel.

updates.title: 新议题入库：《「锅气计划」标准化现炒外卖模式评估与成本定价分析》
updates.title_en: New topic: Project Wok-Hei — standardized fresh-stir-fry takeaway model assessment
updates.topic: 锅气计划外卖模式评估
updates.body: 对7个原始设想逐条对照已有模式下结论：仪式感包装（+1.5-2元/单）、错峰分时定价、供应商公示经得起验证；师傅海选、私域App、租用后厨需合规修正。核心章给出单份成本瀑布（保本点日均310单、净利率5.5%）、28-35元定价带推导与客群承接度验证。基于10个维度约600条公开来源交叉调研。
updates.body_en: All 7 original assumptions benchmarked against live models: ritual unboxing (+¥1.5-2/order), off-peak time-based pricing and supplier transparency hold up; chef auditions, private-domain app and shared-kitchen leasing need compliance fixes. Core chapter delivers a per-order cost waterfall (break-even at 310 orders/day, 5.5% net margin), ¥28-35 pricing band and customer acceptance analysis. Cross-verified across 10 research dimensions and ~600 public sources.

updates.title: 新议题入库：《凡人修仙传 · 全脉络 Wiki》
updates.title_en: New topic: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality — Complete Wiki
updates.body: 凡人流开山之作全考据：主线三书45篇章时间线、三界15境界与韩立14次破境年表、86件宝物图鉴、81人物七类群像与111条关系边图谱；227条目统一ID、交叉引用一一对应，存疑49处皆标印章。
updates.body_en: Complete compendium of the genre-founding xianxia novel: 45-arc timeline across 3 books, 15 realms with Han Li's 14 breakthroughs, 86 treasures, 81 characters and a 111-edge relationship graph; 227 entries with unified IDs and full cross-referencing, 49 doubtful points explicitly marked.

updates.topic: 桶联 BinBot 智能垃圾系统
updates.body: 产品设计概念稿：自动检测打包、腔内喷雾除味、推出交接机构、扫地机器人升降护栏运送与 12 项场景冗余；含 Word/Markdown 版 PRD 下载。
updates.body_en: Concept PRD: auto-seal detection, deodorizing spray, push-out handoff, robot-vacuum transport with lifting guardrail, and 12 redundancy scenarios; Word/Markdown PRD included.
